title: Lov 'n Lake Life
description:
Enjoy a peaceful fall getaway at this inviting 3-bedroom lake retreat. With a fully equipped kitchen and convenient marina access just a short pathway away, it’s an ideal home base for family trips, boating weekends, and relaxing escapes. Spend crisp days near the water, then return to a comfortable space with plenty of room to gather and unwind.

The space
Escape to the lake this fall at a peaceful 3-bedroom retreat designed for relaxing stays near the water. Enjoy crisp mornings, colorful seasonal scenery, and convenient access to the nearby marina just a short pathway away. Inside, a fully equipped kitchen and comfortable gathering spaces make it easy to settle in and spend time together. Whether your plans include boating, exploring the outdoors, enjoying quiet days by the lake, or simply slowing down for the weekend, this inviting home offers plenty of space to relax and recharge. An ideal setting for family trips, weekend escapes, and memorable fall getaways.
